id: NZ1: the noise side of the requirement is band-limited - slow bias and white noise are tolerated, error in the push band is not
registered: 2026-11-04, before any NZ1 run on the registered seeds. Dev evidence (lateral, seeds 1300-1302, 5 N steps): boundary 72.5 N without error; white 20 N 72.5 N (30 N collapsed); OU tau 5 s 20 N 72.5 N and 30 N 73.8 N; OU tau 0.05 s and 0.5 s at 20 N erratic with falls (tau 0.05 s held 5/12 below 70 N). Mechanism (hypothesis): the hold entry uses the estimate minus its slow component and a persistence rule, which removes slow bias and averages white noise but not errors with the time scale of a push.
arm: BUDF/LAT2 arm (oracle push force in the hold decision, no delay, capture-prediction release only) plus error on the oracle: white RA_ORACLE_NOISE or Ornstein-Uhlenbeck RA_ORACLE_OU = 'sigma,tau' (stationary std sigma per axis)

conditions.arms: ref (no error); w20 (white 20 N); ou20f (OU 20 N, tau 0.05 s); ou20m (OU 20 N, tau 0.5 s); ou20s (OU 20 N, tau 5 s); ou30s (OU 30 N, tau 5 s)
conditions.pushes: y+ (lateral) 0.2 s impulse, F in {57.5, 60, ..., 80} N

measures.H_low: zero-step holds (no fall, no step) among the 24 runs with F <= 70 N (6 forces x 4 seeds), the range that the dev reference held completely
measures.boundary: as in LAT2 (reported; may be censored or non-monotone under error)

decision: band-limited noise requirement supported if N1, N2 and N3 all hold
